caseNameFull: Goldfarb et ux. v. Virginia State Bar

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 419 U. S. 963.] Motion of the District of Columbia Bar for reconsideration of motion for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Motion of the Association of the Bar of the City of New York for reconsideration of motion for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted and it is ordered that the brief be filed.

Mr. Justice Marshall and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.*
